description.narrative: This project aims to enhance Jordan's education sector through key initiatives by the GPE System Capacity Grant. The scope includes the completion of Education Sector Analysis (ESA), development of a Partnership Compact, and creation of a new Education Strategic Plan (ESP) that integrates a strategy for Mainstreaming Gender Equality in Education and action plan. This shall help identify and address challenges in the education sector, while aligning with Jordan's educational priorities and national goals for reform. The project focuses on building the MoE's capacity for sustainable policy planning and management, with an emphasis on flexibility to adapt to evolving reforms. The initiatives are aligned with Jordan's Economic Modernization Vision and will ensure the MoE is equipped with the necessary tools to lead and manage the transformation of education. This workplan is created only for agency fees/ overheads.
